lessons.title: Where Am I?
lessons.description: Find out which Tenstorrent environment you landed in and which setup steps apply to it: the cloud pod, a TT-QuietBox 2, or a machine of your own.

lessons.title: Install and Upgrade with tt
lessons.description: Install the tt command line with uv, see what your machine has, preview and apply the tested golden set of driver, firmware and tools, and keep tt itself current.

lessons.title: Hardware Detection
lessons.description: Confirm the hardware is alive and the software can see it: tt device status first, then tt-smi for the raw fields and the diagnosis steps.

lessons.title: Verify Your Setup
lessons.description: Four quick checks before your first model: the stack is current, the hardware is visible, TT-NN imports where it should, and tt-metal source is present if you need it. A diagnostic checkpoint you can come back to.

lessons.title: Find and Pull a Model
lessons.description: Use tt model to see which models run on your hardware, read what each one needs, search the community bundles on Hugging Face, log in, and pull weights ahead of time.

lessons.title: Serve a Model
lessons.description: tt serve starts a model in a container, waits until it answers, and gives you an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Preview, serve, ask it a question, watch logs, stop it.

lessons.title: Serve Without Containers
lessons.description: The cloud pod has no Docker. Serve Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct from the vLLM environment the pod already has, and get the same OpenAI-compatible endpoint tt serve gives everywhere else.

lessons.title: Production Inference with TT-Inference-Server
lessons.description: Deploy Llama-3.1-8B on any Tenstorrent hardware in minutes — n150, n300, T3000, p100, p300c, or TT-QuietBox 2. TT-Inference-Server automates Docker image selection, model download, and server startup with a single command. OpenAI-compatible API ready immediately.

lessons.title: Production Inference with vLLM
lessons.description: Deploy with vLLM - OpenAI-compatible APIs, continuous batching, and enterprise features.

lessons.title: Image Generation with Stable Diffusion XL
lessons.description: Generate high-resolution 1024x1024 images using Stable Diffusion XL Base running natively on your Tenstorrent hardware!
lessons.validationNotes: Added v0.65.1 improvements (VAE perf, encoder optimizations, combined base+refiner pipeline), fixed SD3.5 reference, added SD v1.4 note

lessons.title: Video Generation via Frame-by-Frame Diffusion
lessons.description: Create videos by generating frames with Stable Diffusion on Tenstorrent hardware. Demonstrates hardware scaling from n150 to T3000 - same code, faster performance!

lessons.title: Launch Software
lessons.description: tt launch connects a chat window or a coding agent to the model you are serving. See what can connect, preview, launch Open WebUI or a terminal agent, and meet TT-Studio.

lessons.title: Coding Assistant with Aider
lessons.description: Pair-program with Aider against the model tt is serving: one uv install, one tt launch. Then shape how it codes with a system prompt.

lessons.title: Understanding Custom Training
lessons.description: Learn the fundamentals of custom training on Tenstorrent hardware. Understand the difference between fine-tuning and training from scratch, explore the tt-train framework, and discover when to use each approach for building specialized AI models.

lessons.title: Dataset Fundamentals
lessons.description: Master dataset creation and validation for fine-tuning. Learn JSONL format, quality guidelines, tokenization concepts, and HuggingFace integration. Create high-quality training datasets that produce excellent model results.

lessons.title: Configuration Patterns
lessons.description: Learn YAML-driven training configuration for tt-train: the model-config and training-config split, hyperparameters, device (mesh) configuration, checkpointing, and logging — grounded in the real nanogpt/nanollama configs train_nanogpt.py runs.

lessons.title: Fine-tuning Basics
lessons.description: Run your first real tt-train job on Tenstorrent hardware: build a checkpoint with train_nanogpt.py, then continue training it with --resume — the load-weights-and-keep-going mechanic real fine-tuning uses. Real loss curves and generation samples captured on Blackhole p300c, with an honest account of what a 10M-parameter model actually outputs at this scale.

lessons.title: Multi-Device Training
lessons.description: Verified multi-chip Data Parallel (DDP) training with tt-train — near-linear scaling to 4 Blackhole chips on a TT-QuietBox 2, the mesh graph descriptor fix that unlocks it, plus the documented pattern for n300, T3000, and Galaxy.

lessons.title: Experiment Tracking
lessons.description: Master experiment tracking with file-based logging and Weights & Biases (WandB) integration. Compare hyperparameter variations, visualize training curves, and manage experiments professionally. Make data-driven training decisions.

lessons.title: Model Architecture Basics
lessons.description: A concise tour of modern transformer components — RoPE, GQA, SwiGLU, RMSNorm — and how they map to tt-train's configuration fields. Build them by hand in the from-scratch arc.

lessons.title: Training from Scratch
lessons.description: Configure, launch, monitor, checkpoint, and scale a from-scratch training job with ttml's train_nanogpt.py — the modern nanollama3_char config (RoPE/RMSNorm/SwiGLU/GQA), a real 3000-step loss curve on Blackhole p300c, and an honest look at what driving loss to 0.18 on a tiny corpus actually buys you.

lessons.title: Tenstorrent Cookbook Overview
lessons.description: Welcome to the Tenstorrent Cookbook! Build 5 complete projects that teach fundamental TT-Metalium techniques: Conway's Game of Life, Audio Signal Processing, Mandelbrot Fractals, Image Filters, and Particle Life. Each recipe is a standalone lesson with full source code and visual output.

lessons.title: Recipe 1: Conway's Game of Life
lessons.description: Build Conway's Game of Life using TT-NN parallel tile computing. Learn convolution operations, cellular automata, and visual output generation. Includes classic patterns: gliders, blinkers, and the famous Gosper Glider Gun!

lessons.title: Recipe 2: Audio Signal Processing
lessons.description: Build a real-time audio processing pipeline with TT-NN. Compute mel-spectrograms, detect beats, extract pitch, and apply creative effects. Foundation for speech recognition models like Whisper!

lessons.title: Recipe 3: Mandelbrot Fractal Explorer
lessons.description: Render beautiful fractals with interactive zoom! Demonstrates GPU-style parallel computation and complex number operations. Perfect for understanding embarrassingly parallel workloads on TT hardware.

lessons.title: Recipe 4: Custom Image Filters
lessons.description: Build a library of creative image filters using 2D convolution. From edge detection to artistic effects - learn the techniques used in ResNet50, MobileNetV2, and ViT models!

lessons.title: Recipe 5: Particle Life Simulator
lessons.description: Simulate emergent complexity from simple particle interactions! Features N² force calculations, multi-species dynamics, and multi-device acceleration for TT-QuietBox systems. Beautiful chaos from simple physics!

lessons.title: Image Classification with TT-Forge
lessons.description: Compile a PyTorch MobileNetV2 model for Tenstorrent hardware using forge.compile() — no build required. The forge env is pre-installed: one command to activate, then classify images on real TT silicon.

lessons.title: JAX and PyTorch/XLA on Tenstorrent
lessons.description: Run JAX and PyTorch/XLA computations directly on TT hardware — no install needed. venv-forge ships pjrt_plugin_tt, JAX 0.7.1, and torch-xla pre-installed. Activate, import, and start dispatching tensors to silicon.

lessons.title: Module 1: RISC-V & Computer Architecture
lessons.description: Von Neumann architecture, fetch-decode-execute cycle, and RISC-V fundamentals. Understand how 880 RISC-V processors work by mastering one.

lessons.title: Module 2: The Memory Hierarchy
lessons.description: Cache locality, bandwidth tradeoffs, and near-memory compute. Experience the memory hierarchy from registers to DRAM and understand why memory is the bottleneck in modern computing.

lessons.title: Module 3: Parallel Computing
lessons.description: Amdahl's Law, SPMD patterns, and data parallelism. Scale from 1 to 880 cores and understand when parallelism helps (and when it doesn't).

lessons.title: Module 4: Networks and Communication
lessons.description: Message passing, network topologies, and routing algorithms. Master the Network-on-Chip that connects 880 cores and understand distributed systems principles on a single chip.

lessons.title: Module 5: Synchronization
lessons.description: Race conditions, barriers, and coordination. Learn explicit synchronization on hardware without cache coherence and understand the challenges of concurrent programming at scale.

lessons.title: Module 6: Abstraction Layers
lessons.description: From Python to machine code. Understand the compilation pipeline, when abstractions help performance, and when they hurt. See the full stack from high-level frameworks to RISC-V silicon.

lessons.title: Module 7: Computational Complexity in Practice
lessons.description: Big-O meets real hardware. See why constants matter, how algorithm-hardware co-design achieves breakthrough performance, and why Flash Attention is "O(n)" in practice. The capstone that ties all modules together.

lessons.title: Module 8: Matrix Math and Matmul Labs
lessons.description: Learn matrix math on Tenstorrent by walking Lab 1/2/3 matmul progression: single-core tiles, multi-core work split, and multicast data reuse.

lessons.title: Build TT-Metalium from Source
lessons.description: Clone and build TT-Metalium from source. Required for Direct API (Generator API) lessons and for running TT-Metalium examples directly. TT-QuietBox 2 and pre-configured images do not ship with ~/tt-metal — start here if Check 3 in Verify Your Setup failed.

lessons.title: Bounty Program: Model Bring-Up
lessons.description: Learn how to contribute to the Tenstorrent Bounty Program by bringing up new models. Master TT-Metalium while becoming part of the open source ecosystem. Uses the successful Phi-3 contribution as a case study.

lessons.title: tt-installer by Hand
lessons.description: The installer tt update runs for you, on its own terms: flags, container mode, the Tenstorrent package repository and signing key, and the tt-metalium containers. For specific versions, container-only installs and repairs.

lessons.title: Mix and Match Versions
lessons.description: Where tt keeps its pinned tools, how they relate to a tt-metal you built, the cloud pod's venvs and a container, when each applies, and how to find the exact commits a release was tested with.

lessons.title: Exploring TT-Metalium
lessons.description: Discover what's possible with TT-Metalium! Run TT-NN operations immediately, explore the model zoo, and understand the architecture that powers Tenstorrent hardware — from first script to custom kernels.

lessons.title: Native Video Animation with AnimateDiff
lessons.description: Run Stable Diffusion 1.4 video generation on Blackhole hardware using the TT-NN UNet. Phase 3 injects the full AnimateDiff MotionAdapter at 7 UNet points — no distillation, weights loaded straight from HuggingFace. Fast path: 7.7 s/frame on p300c/TT-QuietBox 2.

lessons.title: OpenClaw AI Assistant on TT-QuietBox 2
lessons.description: Deploy a local AI assistant with Tenstorrent expertise, memory search, and 70B reasoning powered by your TT-QuietBox 2 hardware

lessons.title: Generating Video on TT-QuietBox 2
lessons.description: Go from a fresh TT-QuietBox 2 to AI-generated video clips in one session — Wan2.2-T2V-A14B on 4× Blackhole chips with a GTK4 GUI and automated prompt generation
lessons.validationNotes: Full pipeline validated on TT-QuietBox 2 (2× p300 cards): vendor setup, patches, Wan2.2-T2V-A14B generation (480×832, 80 frames, ~370 s/clip), SkyReels-1.3B (~28 s/clip), Qwen3-0.6B prompt server. Timing data from April 2026 hardware runs.

lessons.title: Local AI Agents on TT-QuietBox 2
lessons.description: Build real AI agents in pure Python — web research, codebase navigation, multi-agent pipelines, and stateful text adventures — all running locally on your TT-QuietBox 2's 32B/70B models
lessons.validationNotes: All five demo scripts validated on TT-QuietBox 2 (p300x2) with Qwen3-32B (hermes parser) and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (llama3_json parser). Tool calling confirmed working. Research agent, code explorer, writing pipeline, and dungeon master all produce expected output.

lessons.title: Introduction to TT-Lang
lessons.description: Write your first TT-Lang kernel: a concurrent compute + data-movement program that runs on the Tensix grid. Try it live in the browser via ttlang-sim-lite.

lessons.title: Twenty-and-Ten Things You Can Do with ttsim
lessons.description: 32 things you can do with the ttsim hardware simulator — no Tenstorrent device required. Runs on any Linux machine, including WSL2 on Windows. Includes N300 and Blackhole two-chip mesh simulation (v1.10.1). Escalates from first kernel to DSP prototyping to a cliffhanger only real hardware can resolve.

lessons.title: ttsim QEMU Bridge: Full-System Simulation
lessons.description: Architecture guide for the ttsim QEMU Bridge — a QEMU fork that presents a virtual Tenstorrent Wormhole PCI device to a Linux VM. Currently draft: two ttsim register stubs are missing before end-to-end ttnn.open_device() works via this path.

lessons.title: Build an LLM from Scratch — Pick Your Altitude
lessons.description: Start an LLM from scratch, TT-native from line one. Meet the 32×32 tile, the reader→compute→writer pipeline, and the "pick your altitude" ladder — grounded for CUDA programmers.

lessons.title: Tokenizer & Data from Scratch
lessons.description: Build a BPE tokenizer and data pipeline from scratch, then see how a token sequence becomes tiled ttnn tensors on Tenstorrent hardware.

lessons.title: Embeddings & the Residual Stream
lessons.description: Build token embeddings and RoPE (rotary position embeddings), meet the residual stream, and write your first TT-Lang inception kernel live in the browser playground.

lessons.title: Attention from Scratch
lessons.description: Build grouped-query attention (GQA) with RoPE'd queries and keys, and author the TT-Lang attention/softmax inception kernel — the reader→compute→writer payoff.

lessons.title: The Transformer Block & the Model
lessons.description: Assemble SwiGLU, RMSNorm, and residuals into a full Llama-style transformer block, stack it into a nano model, and see TT-Lang kernels drop in as ttnn ops. Scale to 80M.

lessons.title: Train It & Run for Real
lessons.description: Write the training loop from scratch — cross-entropy, AdamW, backprop — then train your model for real on Blackhole with ttml. Verified on p300c.

lessons.title: Prove It's Right: Verifying a Model You Trained
lessons.description: "It loads" and "it generates fluent text" are not evidence of correctness. Five verification techniques — ln(vocab), held-out loss, resume continuity, ablation, independent reimplementation — with the measured numbers from a model that passed four checks and was still wrong.

lessons.title: Monkeypatching TT-NN
lessons.description: Change TT-NN / TT-Metalium behavior with the smallest possible trace and without forking tt-metal — add logging, work around a bug, tweak a default, or register a model, all while staying upgrade-safe. Built for TT-QuietBox 2, where ttnn is an installed package with no source tree — reached via the tt-metalium container, not a host-level install.
